purpose: Test whether an unchanged, structurally distinct defensive concept can reliably outperform SPY during causally confirmed bear-deteriorating states without constructing a router.

eras.name: modern
eras.role: multi-regime replication era; not independent of all prior development

design.independence_rule: Strategy identities, mechanisms, costs, states, and acceptance gates are frozen before Phase 007 return outputs are inspected.
design.selection_rule: The challenger roster contains distinct existing mechanisms, not parameter variants. No challenger may be removed because of poor whole-period performance if it has repeatable state-specific evidence.
design.comparison_rule: Every strategy in an era uses identical dates, causal state labels, execution assumptions, and costs. Evidence is reported against SPY at episode and aggregate levels.

defensive_challengers.mechanism: multi-horizon equity trend with defensive-asset fallback
persistent defensive-asset trend selection when equity trend is negative

interpretation_rule: Passing the gates creates a viable specialist candidate for further frozen validation, not authorization to route capital or place trades.
